decisions.reason: The offshore and renewables unit draws on BSM's core ship management competence and targets a growing offshore wind market, and its value is still uncertain while keeping it costs little, so the option stays open.

Crew and travel management complements BSM's large crewing operations, and although pandemic travel restrictions clouded its 2020-2021 results, recovering crew rotations make it worth holding as a low-cost option.
The online vessel information portal is cheap to maintain and supports client transparency, but it could be folded into a broader digital platform, so it is kept with moderate risk of consolidation.

The mobile performance app is a low-cost digital option whose value under decarbonisation regulation is still unresolved, though overlap with other digital tools makes replacement or merger fairly likely.
